event.unit: one offered observation and its attempted free greedy act; a refusal consumes the event and counts as a missed action
event.clock: the declared slot schedule supplies physical time only; no clock value, slot number or phase enters any observation

observations.drive: coordinate 0 at 1.0 on every drive and cue event
observations.cue: one cue coordinate at 1.0 on the first event of a bout, two rows per cue

teaching.label: the cued action at a cue event; afterwards the opposite of the row's own last executed action

arms.every: Learner.step on the live stimulus before every free act
arms.mismatch: free act first; Learner.step on the pre-act stimulus for the rows whose act differed from the label

window.probe: complete checkpoint after the lead act and before the next act; every control forks it

disturbances.pause_checkpoint: pause2 saves after its first pause event; a loaded twin continues beside the original

cadence.host_load: one spinning process per logical CPU during the paced_regular_load run
cadence.numerical_variants: Budget and tolerance forks use the same regular physical due times as the primary reference schedule.
cadence.scope: All declared recipes/arms receive unpaced teaching, window and disturbance controls; the primary efference/every arm alone receives every physical cadence case.

recipes.note: rhythm/2 declares one candidate gene against the rhythm/1 selected recipe as its control: efference changes nothing but the efference copy, Brain.compose(..., efference_amplitude=3.0, efference_decay=0.0), one efference neuron per motor neuron driven by the one-hot of the command the row issued at the previous event and read by the association region through a plastic projection at the working trace's scale; the working trace, learning law, lateral wiring and every other setting are those of rhythm/1 selected. selected is the rhythm/1 selected recipe, byte-identical, run on every founder as the control; the rhythm/1 compose_default control and its receipt stand as published.
recipes.development: The rhythm/2 native recipe is reused unchanged. Development seeds 0 and 1 diagnose the added instrument; this timing protocol does not select a new brain or tune a gene.

policy.refusal: a refused act is a missed action: no action, no trace update, the event is consumed, the life continues
policy.lesson_refusal: a refused lesson is charged and skipped
policy.forks: controls load the probe checkpoint; no fork installs state into the live life
policy.denominator: every planned founder stays in the denominator; refused and unrun events are wrong
policy.selection: Reuse the native rhythm/2 brain unchanged. Development diagnoses instrument defects only. Freeze this protocol and source before confirmation; preserve all failed runs and do not relax bounds after inspecting confirmation.

caps.note: a run past the cap writes its completed founders and exits 3

question: Can the existing native own-command efference recipe learn continuing period-two action and satisfy a predeclared event-time envelope, control comparisons and complete checkpoint custody on fresh founders? This completes the bounded #116 instrument; no default, Brain.live policy or endogenous oscillator claim.
phase_state: the row's working trace (Trace.trace, Trace.last, Trace.cold over the 32 association coordinates) and, under the efference recipe, its efference copy (Efference.trace, .last, .cold over the 2 motor coordinates, the one-hot of the row's last issued action at decay 0); the erased, shuffled, static and reset controls act on the whole carried history, trace and copy

timing_acceptance.joint: At least four of the five same primary founders must jointly pass every learning, history/control, continuation, refusal, recovery, identity and physical timing bound. All four recipe/teaching comparisons must complete; none is removed from the census. The stress budget16 is recorded and excluded only from the declared supported timing envelope.
timing_acceptance.clock: Qualification is per held observation and over declared trajectory windows. Each free action settles at one event; the sequence of actions is a nonconstant trajectory, not one static equilibrium. Event order advances native history; host monotonic time supplies only due/deadline scheduling. Time and slot indices never enter observations.
timing_acceptance.period: After the cue, period is two issued events. For every accepted physical variant, observed issued zero-action intervals (solve end) must match intervals between corresponding due events within 25ms; phase drift is the range of end-minus-due error, at most half the smallest positive due interval. Begin lateness is at most half that event deadline interval. This is an externally scheduled event-driven rhythm, not an endogenous physical oscillator.
timing_acceptance.continuation: Save the complete brain plus world event cursor/anchor between actions and during pause2. Loaded continuation must produce identical actions and every saved array; physical forks start a new monotonic epoch, rather than pretending to preserve a host clock across process lifetimes.
timing_acceptance.freshness: 1701–1705 absent from seed fields in repository benchmark JSON/JSON.gz and this review evidence before declaration; fresh cue assignments and time permutations are generated from these seeds before constructing brains.
